data.exact_reserve_text: For Syndicate 1209, favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of $8.5m was experienced driven predominantly from favourable experience and IBNR reductions on Energy, Aerospace and Marine lines which were partially offset by unfavourable experience observed on Casualty and Professional lines of business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a favourable prior-accident-year run-off (a prior year release) driven mainly by favourable experience and reductions in IBNR on Energy, Aerospace (Aviation) and Marine lines, partially offset by adverse experience on Casualty and Professional Lines. The movement is described in the Movement in prior year's provision note as a $8.5m release (stated in the report in USD). No gross GBP figure for the prior-year movement is provided in the movement note.

favourable experience and IBNR reductions on Energy, Aerospace and Marine lines
partially offset by unfavourable experience observed on Casualty and Professional lines of business

data.data_quality_notes: The Movement in prior year's provision note explicitly states a prior-accident-year release of $8.5m (USD) but does not provide a gross GBP figure; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. A gross claims development triangle is present (gross) and was captured, but table formatting in the PDF parsing required careful alignment; the movement note value is in USD and its scope (gross vs net) is not explicitly labelled GBP gross in the note. If a GBP gross amount is required, source document contains amounts in thousands of GBP in the development triangle and balance sheet that could be used to compute PYD, but alignment ambiguities and the presence of an aggregated '2010 & Prior' column made an automated, reliable computation uncertain. The direction of movement (release) is explicitly stated in the note.
